Name: Kheshari Dal 500 gm
LongDescription: Kheshari Dal (also known as Toor Dal or Pigeon Pea in some regions) is a commonly used lentil in South Asian cooking. Known for its yellow color and mild flavor, it is a rich source of protein, fiber, and essential vitamins.
